pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
Fully aquatic doll. Excels at underwater exploration and attacking with lasers.

HP: 120. Regen IV + Resistance II + Fire Resistance. Free water movement.

pages.title: Aura & Abilities
pages.text:
Melee/Archer mode fires a laser (20 magic damage, armor-piercing, 1.5s charge, 1s cooldown).

Aura (16 blocks): hostile aquatic mobs cannot target doll or owner. Owner gets Water Breathing + Aqua Affinity + Mining Fatigue removal.

pages.title: Fishing Mode
pages.text: Uses standard loot table. Bite time halved, double catch. Enchantments on the rod (Luck of the Sea, Lure) are recognized and applied.

pages.title: How to Obtain
pages.text: Craft the Sea Doll Head, then the Sea Doll Egg. Name the egg on an anvil to summon.
